card.title: Choose What Matters More
card.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They're calling your audition number. Do you want the part enough to let them hear you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want it. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can walk you in or drive you home. Which want am I helping?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can promise I'll stay. Is that enough to risk the audition, or are we going home?

mechanism: A asks B to choose the desired audition despite possible embarrassment, offering presence rather than impossible emotional safety.
confusable: Unlike simple encouragement, A must make the conflict between safety and the wanted result explicit.
comparison: D106-a offers staying without guaranteeing no laughter; D106-b refuses a reassuring prewritten answer as a condition of honesty.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
